work_package: C: fixed-grid piecewise controls and total derivatives through initial conditions
snapshot_context: Working tree on top of the committed A/B implementation; source hashes identify the validated C files. Prior result files retain historical source hashes and results.

api.method: Simulator.compile(*, parameters, times, controls=(), control_times=None, integrator="cvodes", integrator_options=None)
api.control_layout: Rows in control selection order, columns in fixed interval order
api.control_types: Whole time-only Var or mutable/immutable Param components
api.control_boundaries: Finite, strictly increasing, include both ContinuousSet bounds
api.control_semantics: Right-held on [s_j, s_(j+1)); continuous state at switches; final state uses last amplitude
api.implementation: One normalized unit-interval CVODES map composed with mapaccum over observation/switch union; amplitudes packed into constant interval parameters; physical time retained
api.initial_conditions: Independent x0 input, symbolic CasADi composition for total derivatives; no new IC API
api.quadrature_error_control: Required True, as selected by user
api.tolerances: Positive scalar reltol and abstol only; vector weights and derivative augmentation overrides refused

analytic_and_derivative_checks.affine_phase_reference: Exact exponential/integral formulas and x0, parameter, amplitude derivatives; zero and nonzero rates
analytic_and_derivative_checks.multiple_controls: Two controls in reversed declaration order; two JVPs and two VJPs; all four forward-adjoint products within 3e-7
analytic_and_derivative_checks.total_objective: Nonlinear shared ICs, repeated control amplitudes, integral state, explicit terminal parameter cost and control penalty; analytic direct and adjoint checks
analytic_and_derivative_checks.finite_difference_checks: All three total parameter components; minimum maximum error below 1e-6; improvement over largest step by factor greater than ten
analytic_and_derivative_checks.timing: Sparse, initial-only and 51 dense observations; exact switches and immediately adjacent observations; unused future amplitudes; shifted nonautonomous time
analytic_and_derivative_checks.narrow_pulse: Adjacent floating-point boundaries with amplitude 1e16 retain finite pulse area; scaled direct and adjoint checks
analytic_and_derivative_checks.normalized_duration_parameter: Analytic primal, direct duration derivative and adjoint rate/duration derivatives
analytic_and_derivative_checks.nonlinear_control: Squared amplitudes including a stationary control value, with empty p
analytic_and_derivative_checks.state_preservation: Model values/fixity, caller options/arrays, existing simulation result and input ordering preserved after successful compilation, derivative evaluation and constructor failures

uncovered_compile_refusals: control not indexed by current time

test_commands: PYTHONPATH=<checkout> COVERAGE_FILE=<new-unique-file> <env-python> -m coverage run --source=pyomo.dae.simulator -m pytest pyomo/dae/tests -q

PYTHONPATH=<checkout> <lean-env-python> -m unittest pyomo.dae.tests.test_simulator pyomo.dae.tests.test_simulator_interface pyomo.dae.tests.test_simulator_compile pyomo.dae.tests.test_simulator_controls -q

checks.executable_examples: Both examples and analytic assertions pass on both versions

coverage_harness_note: The instrumented 3.8.1 run emitted Python multiprocessing semaphore cleanup diagnostics, including FileNotFoundError after passing tests. Test and coverage process exit codes were zero. The regular 3.8.2 run was clean. These are harness diagnostics, not numerical integration failures.
known_limits: ODEs only; no algebraic equations or algebraic initialization derivatives
Fixed common control boundary grid; no switch-time derivatives, events or resets
Scalar Var parameter selection and vector tolerances remain unsupported
Only first derivative products are qualified; no explicit Pyomo sensitivity-equation transformation
Previously recorded native BDF stiff-adjoint limitations remain; no algorithm fallback
Dense observations restart CVODES each interval on controlled maps; no large-grid performance qualification
